categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in construction of residential and commercial buildings for sale and lease. Subsidiaries operate in solar energy applications, real estate brokerage, tourism agency, and property rental management. The main revenue driver is construction, accounting for over 99% of consolidated revenue, with minor contributions from rental income.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs professional construction management, strict quality control, and collaborates with skilled contractors to ensure high-quality building projects. It integrates green building concepts, energy-saving designs, and sustainable construction materials. Solar energy projects involve planning, integration, and supervision of photovoltaic installations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include homebuyers and commercial tenants primarily in the Greater Taipei and Taoyuan regions. The real estate brokerage and leasing services target property buyers and renters, including clients in mainland China through subsidiaries. The solar energy segment targets renewable energy markets and related business clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Taiwan, especially Taipei City, New Taipei City, and Taoyuan City. Subsidiaries extend services to Xiamen, China, focusing on tourism and property rental. Solar energy projects are planned in Miaoli County, Taiwan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the real estate supply chain, including land development, construction, sales, and leasing. It outsources construction work to contractors and manages project planning and sales internally. The solar energy business involves project planning and integration services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing product differentiation through quality construction and customer service, strengthening brand value, and pursuing sustainable growth. The company plans to expand in urban renewal projects and diversify into green energy industries, particularly solar energy. R&D investment is minimal, focusing on market research and product planning rather than technological innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through sales of constructed residential and commercial properties. Additional income streams include rental income from properties and service fees from real estate brokerage and tourism management. The company also gains from project development and land sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a quality-focused real estate developer with strong urban renewal capabilities and a growing presence in green energy. It competes with other developers in Taipei and Taoyuan by emphasizing construction quality, project planning, and customer satisfaction. Specific competitors are not named in the report.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$625 billion in the latest fiscal year, a significant increase from the previous year. Net profit turned positive at around NT$301 million with improved profitability ratios. The company shows a strong growth trajectory driven by project completions and sales recognition.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes superior construction quality, meticulous project planning, and excellent after-sales service to create irreplaceable products. It aims to enhance brand value and competitiveness by focusing on product uniqueness and customer satisfaction. Sustainable practices and green building integration further differentiate its offerings.
